main_body: A round leafy canopy made of several lobes, standing on a single brown trunk
top_band: At x=29: outline at row 0, then light-to-mid green (L110/85) at rows 1-7 on the canopy crown, then a darker lobe underside (L58) at rows 8-10. The lobes are lit on top and shaded below.
evidence: The canopy reads as domed lobes lit on top, with dark shaded undersides and dark outline rows between lobes. The trunk (rows 47-77, about 31 rows) is a vertical south face with a flared root base. No receding side face. It is an organic tree, so the dome shading and trunk satisfy the 3/4 contract.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 15 distinct colours and a median of 8 colours per tile. The references have about 108 colours per tile and 427-567 distinct colours. The canopy has about 5-6 greens, but they are applied as large smooth blobs with sparse pixel dithering. Beodeul leaf clumps are individually highlighted with many greens. Outlines are mostly tinted dark green or brown (only 20% neutral), and 5x5 flat-fill coverage is 0%. The trunk is a simple brown ramp with a few vertical grain lines. Tile information is far below the references, so it looks thinner and flatter next to them.
